contribution.title: Contribuir
contribution.body:
- Relatar [problemas e erros](https://github.com/jhotadhari/straymap/issues)
- Fazer perguntas ou sugerir funções nas [discussões](https://github.com/jhotadhari/straymap/discussions)
- [Bifurcar o repositório](https://github.com/jhotadhari/straymap) e abrir pull requests para o branch `development`

credits.title: Créditos
credits.body:
- Construído em torno do [mapsforge's vtm](https://github.com/mapsforge/vtm) via [react-native-mapsforge-vtm](https://github.com/jhotadhari/react-native-mapsforge-vtm)
- **Framework:** [React](https://react.dev/) · [React Native](https://reactnative.dev/) · [TypeScript](https://www.typescriptlang.org/) · [Babel](https://babeljs.io/)
- **Estado e dados:** [Redux Toolkit](https://redux-toolkit.js.org/) · [React Query](https://tanstack.com/query) · [drizzle-orm](https://orm.drizzle.team/) · [op-sqlite](https://github.com/OP-Engineering/op-sqlite)
- **UI:** [react-native-paper](https://callstack.github.io/react-native-paper/) · [react-native-paper-dates](https://github.com/web-ridge/react-native-paper-dates) · [react-native-reanimated](https://docs.swmansion.com/react-native-reanimated/) · [react-native-gesture-handler](https://docs.swmansion.com/react-native-gesture-handler/) · [react-native-svg](https://github.com/software-mansion/react-native-svg) · [react-native-sortables](https://github.com/mzuender/react-native-sortables) · [@react-native-vector-icons](https://github.com/react-native-vector-icons) · [Font-GIS](https://github.com/viglino/font-gis) · [react-native-safe-area-context](https://github.com/th3rdwave/react-native-safe-area-context) · [@react-native-community/blur](https://github.com/react-native-community/blur)

- **Mapas e geo:** [Turf.js](https://turfjs.org/) · [react-native-brouter](https://github.com/jhotadhari/react-native-brouter) · [@tmcw/togeojson](https://github.com/placemark/togeojson)
- **i18n:** [i18next](https://www.i18next.com/) · [react-i18next](https://react.i18next.com/) · [intl-pluralrules](https://www.npmjs.com/package/intl-pluralrules)
- **Utilitários:** [lodash-es](https://lodash.com/) · [dayjs](https://day.js.org/) · [formatcoords](https://github.com/nerik/formatcoords) · [slugify](https://github.com/simov/slugify) · [sprintf-js](https://github.com/alexei/sprintf.js) · [semver-compare](https://github.com/substack/semver-compare) · [@ungap/structured-clone](https://github.com/ungap/structured-clone) · [defaults](https://github.com/tmpvar/defaults) · [react-native-fs](https://github.com/itinance/react-native-fs) · [react-native-uuid](https://github.com/eugenehp/react-native-uuid) · [react-native-default-preference](https://github.com/kevinresol/react-native-default-preference) · [react-native-scoped-storage](https://github.com/ammarahm-ed/react-native-scoped-storage) · [react-native-popover-view](https://github.com/SteffeyDev/react-native-popover-view) · [@klarna/react-native-vector-drawable](https://github.com/klarna-incubator/react-native-vector-drawable)
- **Fonte:** [Jangly Walk](https://www.fonts4free.net/jangly-walk-font.html) © [Jakob Fischer / pizzadude.dk](https://www.pizzadude.dk)
- **Logo:** primeiro plano baseado em [hotpot.ai/logo-generator](https://hotpot.ai/logo-generator), fundo baseado em [World PNGs by Vecteezy](https://www.vecteezy.com/free-png/world)

freeSoftware.title: Software Livre
freeSoftware.body:
Straymap é [Software Livre](https://www.gnu.org/philosophy/free-sw.en.html) ([código fonte](https://github.com/jhotadhari/straymap)):

> "Software Livre" significa que **as pessoas usuárias têm a liberdade de executar, copiar, distribuir, estudar, mudar e melhorar o software**. É uma questão de liberdade, não de preço.

privacy.title: Privacidade
privacy.body:
Straymap **não contém rastreadores** de nenhum tipo. Todos os dados permanecem no dispositivo — nada é coletado, enviado ou compartilhado.

O app funciona completamente offline, com uma exceção: a camada de mapa `online-raster-xyz`, que solicita blocos rasterizados de uma fonte online que você mesmo escolhe.*

\* Qualquer solicitação a um servidor transmite seu endereço IP — isso é tecnicamente inevitável.

whereToGetMaps.title: Onde obter mapas?
whereToGetMaps.body:
- **Mapas vetoriais** (mapsforge) e **estilos de renderização XML**: [OpenAndroMaps](https://www.openandromaps.org/en/downloads)
- **Mapas raster de visão geral** (MBtiles): [OpenAndroMaps general maps](https://www.openandromaps.org/en/downloads/general-maps)
- **Modelos digitais de elevação** (hgt, 3 segundos de arco): [viewfinderpanoramas.org](https://viewfinderpanoramas.org/Coverage%20map%20viewfinderpanoramas_org3.htm)
